findings.run_context: Brand Manager Bot / App 2.0 gap closure / local sample data
findings.issue: Dashboard existed before the Phase 3 data contract was implemented.
findings.evidence: docs/brand-manager-app-2.0-implementation-plan.md previously marked dashboard work as deferred.
findings.why_it_matters: Operators could treat prototype data as live findings if the dashboard is not schema-backed.
findings.likely_cause: Prototype UI was created before the finding-store workflow was finalized.
findings.suggested_action: Use schema-backed local data and keep action history before using the dashboard operationally.

findings.run_context: Brand Manager Bot / App 2.0 gap closure / local sample data
findings.issue: Performance interpretation needs a hygiene gate before CPA, ROAS, or CVR claims.
findings.evidence: skills/performance-system/SKILL.md requires source data and tracking status before interpretation.
findings.why_it_matters: Performance recommendations can be misleading when tracking or URL hygiene is unverified.
findings.likely_cause: Phase 2 routing existed before a dashboard-ready record flow was added.
findings.suggested_action: Mark reports blocked, qualified, or interpretable based on hygiene status.

findings.run_context: Brand Manager Bot / App 2.0 gap closure / local sample data
findings.issue: Historical brand labels do not always match current brand folder names.
findings.evidence: logs/context-usage/token-data.json includes historical labels such as Fantasy XI-AG.
findings.why_it_matters: Dashboards should display historical labels as recorded instead of silently rewriting history.
findings.likely_cause: Brand folders were renamed or reorganized during migration.
findings.suggested_action: Treat historical labels as source data unless a brand alias registry is supplied.
